task: All 2015-2024 historical index removals: source-only holding-end continuity audit
scope: All intervals with end_exclusive in 2015-01-01 through 2024-12-31, expected 218 events; retain interval identity, do not deduplicate repeated entries.

Use observed SPY date set solely as source calendar proxy. For each removal choose prior calendar-month last SPY day as formation, removal-month last SPY day as end observation. State this is information-observation availability, not execution eligibility or a portfolio test.
Check whether that interval was a member at formation, using [start,end). If not, flag not in prior-month cohort instead of treating as held.

For exact ticker and date, preserve row counts, close/adj_close/volume/source and halted/no-trade flags; finite positive quotes with positive volume are observable candidates, never prove executable sales or terminal value.

For each removal report last observed pre-removal quote, first nonhalt positive-volume post-removal quote (if any up to end2024), exact target-month-end quote; no carry-forward/alias price copying/zero fill.

If target quote absent or halt occurs, state terminal security/cash/share entitlement unverified; do not discard cases or infer liquidation from index removal. Even continuous quotes do not certify merger treatment.

Read available exit_gaps matching SIVB/SBNY and save exact rows with uncertainty. Report counts event types, formation held/not-held, target quote candidate/missing/bad/halt; direct cases Chubb old, JCI old, Allergan old, SIVB, SBNY.
No network, OP, factor/portfolio returns, outcome-based pool removal, production code or data overwrite. Create-only output and SHA receipt with source/run/readback.
